research_question: Does verified-origin narrative add predictive value over a validation-selected numeric model in a later USDM period?
target: CONUS DSCI, official API GetDSCI; a distinct task unless historical target identity is established
prediction_time: Friday 00:00 America/New_York after the last observed Tuesday map; forecast starts the following Tuesday
release_evidence: Document-explicit release date > official schedule inferred > unknown. Archive modification times do not prove first public availability. Strict exact-publication mode excludes inferred and unknown dates.

text.method: train-only TF-IDF + TruncatedSVD + ridge residual correction
text.residual_training: strictly chronological out-of-fit residuals from three inner train folds of the chosen numeric model family; deep folds use calibration-selected epochs but no held-out labels

selection: Calibrate all numeric candidates using train-only weights; select numeric family by calibration MSE, ties by candidate name; refit selected family on train+cal. Text residual alpha chosen on calibration with train-only base; final correction trained from OOF train residuals only. Static fusion weight chosen on decision grid only if mean and both-half benefit positive; do not refit on decision.
acceptance: No guaranteed improvement. Later temporal historical evaluation, not prospective forecasting or a new-domain test. Missing official text is recorded and falls back. Live archive revisions and exact first-release uncertainty remain explicit. No tuning after test scores.
excluded_work: Do not overwrite rounds 8-13 or original teammate files. No automatic push. All new downloads and caches on D drive.
